originalPrompt:
## Context & Goal

Integrate the Google Analytics toolkit into VoiceOS via Composio using OAuth2. This enables the VoiceOS agent to run analytics reports and retrieve metadata on behalf of authenticated users.

## Implementation Requirements

- Use **Composio** as the MCP provider for all Google Analytics tool calls
- Auth method: **OAuth2** — implement the Composio OAuth2 connection flow for Google Analytics
- Expose only the following **approved tools** (no others):
    - `Run report`
    - `Run realtime report`
    - `Get metadata`
- UX/UI requirements:
    - OAuth2 connect/disconnect UI for Google Analytics account linking
    - Loading states during report queries
    - Success/error toast notifications for failed queries
    - Clear error messaging if OAuth token expires or is revoked

## Relevant Files / Code Paths

- Composio SDK integration layer
- OAuth2 connection flow component
- Tool execution handler

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ]  Google Analytics OAuth2 connection flow works end-to-end via Composio
- [ ]  All 3 approved tools are callable by the VoiceOS agent
- [ ]  No unapproved tools are exposed
- [ ]  Loading states render correctly during report queries
- [ ]  OAuth token refresh is handled gracefully
